evidence.quote: Harley-Davidson Motor Company administers the H-D® Online Store on behalf of and as agent for participating dealerships.
The Selling Dealer is the dealership that will receive credit for your purchases, and that is officially responsible for the sales that fill your orders
Products shipped to the dealer are usually available within 5 - 7 days.

draft.notes: The FAQ assigns online-store sales responsibility to participating dealerships, supporting marketplace classification despite the Harley-branded storefront. Motorcycle retail is not one of the supplied categories, so candidateCategory is null.
